name: zero distance office
normative-structure: Some office must face the user the firm exists to serve, and hold the one contract every unit touching that user's outcome is bound by. It persists across incumbents because the requirement it answers is founding, not incidental: distance is the number of inferential steps between a person's work and knowledge of whether a user was served, and a firm with no seated office at zero distance has, by construction, every unit optimizing for whatever proxy stands closer than the user — a manager's assessment, an internal specification, an aggregate. The office holds the chain-group contract to the end user, states the leading goal that contract is benchmarked against, and answers for nothing standing between the firm's work and the user it was for.
theory-basis: rendanheyi/ling-juli: zero distance is the founding requirement that nothing stand between the person doing work and the user whose value that work creates — no management layer, no internal proxy, no aggregate — per lib/emsenn/services/561-group/services/coesite-clearing/services/union-officer-academy/services/management-thought/rendanheyi/content/glossary/terms/ling-juli.md

rendanheyi/shichang-xiaowei: the market micro-enterprise faces an end user directly and owns the user relationship while obtaining everything else by contract — this office is the seat that relation requires and presently has none

rendanheyi/lianqun-heyue: the chain group holds one contract to the end user, binding every constituent micro-enterprise to one outcome and one shared pool rather than a chain of internal specifications

rendanheyi/yinling-mubiao: the leading goal is benchmarked against the best performance available anywhere in the market, not incremented from the firm's own history — the target this office's contract commits to
unrealized: no seated office presently faces any user — the requirement's own observation stands: the firm's wage-payer per ren-dan-chou is unowned, and this office is the naming of that absence, not yet its correction
no chain-group contract has been formed to any end user, so 'the single contract every unit is party to' is asserted as the standard and not yet built as a record
no leading goal has been benchmarked against the market for any of the firm's work, so the target this office's contract would commit to does not yet exist
